overall: The AG found the Board violated the OML by discussing lease terms in executive session with the prospective lessee present, which defeated Purpose 6. The Chair's declaration was proper, the rest of the session was proper, and the violation was not found intentional.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board met in executive session without a valid statutory purpose; the lessee joined the Purpose 6 session on the lease of a town building.
allegations.key_passage: For this reason, we find that the second part of the August 27 executive session was held without a proper purpose and the Board therefore violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Part of the same executive session, before the prospective lessee joined, was challenged as lacking a purpose; the AG found that portion proper under Purpose 6.
allegations.key_passage: was proper because the Board discussed both the rental fee and other terms that it wished to negotiate with the prospective lessee.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Chair did not sufficiently establish, before entering executive session, that open discussion would harm the Board's negotiating position.
allegations.key_passage: Rather, the chair is merely required under the Law to make a statement to that effect.

allegations.summary: Complainants urged a finding that the violation was intentional; the AG declined to make that finding because the Chair sought clarification and believed the session was proper.
allegations.key_passage: Even though the Chair was incorrect, on these facts we decline to find the Board's violation of the Open Meeting Law to be intentional.

allegations.summary: Not alleged in the complaints; the AG noted in a footnote that the generic 'Executive Session may be held as needed' notice item is not specific enough.
allegations.key_passage: A general, standing executive session topic is not sufficiently specific to satisfy the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, because it does not provide any detail about what type of discussion will be had or what executive session purpose the session will be conducted under.

allegations.summary: Additional allegations raised in the request for further review but not in the original complaints were not reviewed.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review additional allegations contained in the request for further review that were not included in the original complaints filed with the public body.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
